notes: Library → Filters: a new Missing info filter (poster, description, genres, year, match, episode titles, descriptions and pictures; any or all of them), with the language, subtitle and lock filters in the same panel. Settings in groups: every section opens and closes, with a search box and a jump bar. The Update from a file text is no longer squeezed. Check my setup now checks the phone app's sync folder and says why Plex is reached over the internet at home. Internet Archive: a kept file can be deleted right after it finishes playing on Windows.
